tourLiveText: Live channels from all your sources start here. The TV guide shows what's on now and next.
tourVodText: Browse each source's movie and series posters, filter by decade, and save titles to My List to keep them in one place.
tourSearchText: Find channels, movies and series across all your sources.
whatsNewEmpty: No release notes for this version yet.
noteMultiviewText: Watch up to four live channels at once. Click a tile to give it the sound.
noteParentalText: Lock channels, groups or titles behind a PIN, or hide them completely.
noteMyListText: Save movies and series from their poster and find them again on the dashboard.
noteListsText: Mix channels from any source into lists, and rename or hide single channels.
noteGuideText: Search programmes, jump to any day and time, and record every airing of a show.
noteSubtitlesText: Load .srt, .vtt or .ass files and set the size, color, background and position.
noteSleepText: Stop playback after a set time or when the programme ends, with a gentle fade.
noteVodFiltersText: Filter movies and series by year and hide what you have already watched.
noteStatsText: See your viewing time per day and your top channels and titles.
noteLooksText: Seven accent colors, an OLED black theme, compact density and interface size.
noteScreenshotText: Press S during playback to save the current frame as an image.
noteSpeedText: Posters and logos are kept on disk, so grids load at once the next time.
noteM3uSeriesText: M3U episodes are grouped into series with seasons, like those of Xtream and Stalker sources.
noteFasterText: Search, the guide, imports, zapping and long lists are much quicker, also on large libraries.
noteProgrammeSearchText: Search and the command palette also find guide programmes and open the guide at them.
noteGuideToolsText: Zoom the guide, show your favorites or a list in it, shift guide times per source or channel, and zap through favorites.
notePictureText: Set the aspect ratio, crop or zoom in the player menu, and play ClearKey-protected M3U channels.
noteSourceUpdatesText: New sources refresh automatically, a pasted playlist can be replaced in place, and Xtream accounts can send their own User-Agent.
noteDownloadsMoreTitle: More to download and catch up on
noteDownloadsMoreText: Download whole seasons, M3U movies and past programmes. Catch-up works by the hour on channels without a guide.
noteRemotePlayText: The remote plays, pauses and stops, and lists your channels without opening Live TV first.
notePhoneLayoutText: Hide the sidebar on small screens, use a smaller mini player, and tap the video to show the controls. A button opens the channel list in fullscreen.
noteMessagesText: Errors say what to try in your language, and dates, numbers and key names follow it.
noteWindowStartText: Choose in Settings how the window opens.
noteFixesText: Imports, the guide, playback, recording, downloads and backups are more reliable.
tourCoachText: Search finds channels, movies and series in all your sources. The command palette gets you anywhere else.
